title: Turkish Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Turkish-inspired lamb wrap, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. The combination of lamb, spices, and fresh herbs will transport your taste buds to the streets of Istanbul.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Cook the lamb for 5-7 minutes, until it is no longer pink.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the lamb and stir to combine.
Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the lamb mixture onto the tortilla, leaving a small border around the edges.
Top the lamb with parsley and drizzle with olive oil.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
